changes_made.explanation: This paper is about information retrieval and provenance tracking, not NLG. The 'metadata generation' extracts existing metadata from text rather than generating new language. All NLG-related metadata has been removed.
ROUGE metrics are used to evaluate metadata extraction quality, not NLG outputs. Since the paper doesn't address NLG tasks, these metrics are not relevant for NLG evaluation.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper.
No human evaluations of generated outputs are conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper is about information retrieval and provenance tracking (identifying source articles for claims in fact-checking articles), not natural language generation. The 'metadata generation' component extracts existing metadata from text rather than generating new language. The ROUGE metrics are used to evaluate the quality of extracted metadata, not NLG outputs. Therefore, this paper should not be included in NLG evaluation research.
